morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，整词记忆；词首 pl 为辅音连缀，tun 不是后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 排：通常由约30至40名军人组成、由一名陆军中尉领导并分为三个班的军事单位。
senses.en_definition: A military unit of approximately 30–40 soldiers, commanded by a lieutenant and usually divided into three sections.
senses.ms_definition: Sekumpulan tentera, antara 30 hingga 40 orang, yang diletakkan di bawah pimpinan seorang leftenan, biasanya dibahagikan kepada tiga seksyen.
senses.nuances: 军事编制名词，层级通常在 seksyen（班）之上、kompeni（连）之下；实际人数依单位编制而异。不能泛指任何一群军人。定义依据：[PRPM：platun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=platun)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Satu platun tentera telah dikerahkan untuk membantu operasi pemindahan mangsa banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 军方已派出一个排，协助撤离水灾灾民。
dual_scenarios.en: A platoon of soldiers has been deployed to assist with the evacuation of flood victims.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Abang aku dah sampai kat kem dengan platun dia.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Abang saya sudah tiba di kem bersama-sama platunnya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我哥已经跟他那个排一起到军营了。
dual_scenarios.en: My brother has arrived at camp with his platoon.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人之间使用的第一人称代词。
dah 对应 sudah；kat 对应 di。
platun dia 是口语所属结构，正式表达可用 platunnya。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Abang kau dah sampai kat kem dengan platun dia ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah abang awak sudah tiba di kem bersama-sama platunnya?
messages.zh: 你哥已经跟他那个排一起到军营了吗？
messages.en: Has your brother arrived at camp with his platoon?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia baru mesej tadi. Esok platun dia nak mula latihan.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, dia baru menghantar mesej sebentar tadi. Platunnya akan memulakan latihan esok.
messages.zh: 到了，他刚才才发消息来。他们排明天开始训练。
messages.en: Yes, he just texted. His platoon starts training tomorrow.

etymology.historical_story: Platun is borrowed from English platoon, illustrating how military terminology travels with institutions and training. In Malaysian Malay, the spelling represents the borrowed word as two syllables. The dictionary describes a lieutenant-led group normally divided into three sections, giving the term a specific organizational meaning rather than the loose sense of a crowd. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/platun).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 platoon 的声音压成 pla-tun，脑中同时摆出三个班组成一个排；tun 不是可以拆开的词缀。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身语气中性。称呼实际军官时，应依其军衔和场合使用适当称谓，不能直接以 platun 称呼个人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于军事新闻、训练和编制讨论；谈实际单位时，应核实其编制名称，避免把排、连和营混称。
